name: morf-x
description: MORF-X: find your tone. Morph a block on a Line 6 POD Go, Helix or HX Effects between five tones, live over USB.

scripts.pack-mac: npm run web && electron-packager . MORF-X --platform=darwin --arch=arm64,x64 --out=dist --overwrite --icon=res/MORF-X.icns --app-bundle-id=uk.toneshift.morfx --ignore=^/dist --ignore=^/res/iconset --ignore=^/linux && sh sign-mac.sh
scripts.pack-all: npm run pack-mac && npm run pack-win && npm run pack-linux && npm run zip

author: Mark Daniels (ToneShift)
